tei:div.tei:p: bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang gi lhan thabs bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ 'dir bka' gdams glegs bam gyi thig le bcu drug gi dbang chog rnying pa la kha skong don la thob nges 'ga' zhig brjod par bya ste/ 'di glegs bam tshang ma rang thugs la bzhugs pa 'brom gzhon nu blo gros kyis mdzad par snang na'ang*/ dkyil 'khor thig rtsa ha cang bsdus shing*/ bris chad yun ring lon pa zhig kyang yin par snang bas/ shin tu gdab dka' bar 'dug pa la/ don gyi thob pa/ rgyas pa sgo bcu drug pa byed ces sogs la bsten nas 'di ltar bya ste/ rgyas pa sgo bcu drug la/ 'bring sgo bzhi pa/ bsdus pa sgo gcig ma ste/ re re zhing yang rab rtsig pa/ 'dod snam/ pha gu dra phyed/ shar bu/ mda' yab| sgo sgo khyud/ 'gram logs rnams spyi dang 'dra ba/ 'bring rtsig pa 'dod snam dra phyed/ sgo dang sgo khyud tsam yod pa/ tha ma rtsig pa 'dod snam tsam ste/ rgyas pa'i rgyas pa sogs gsum gsum du 'gyur mod/ rgyas pa'i rgyas pa dang*/ de yang nang ma nyis 'gyur phyi ma la byed pa sogs ni sgrub mi nus shing*/ nang du mi shong bas/ spyir bzo thig ste/ bcu drug po thams cad kyang rtsig pa sogs/ zheng tshad mnyam pa byas na rgyas pa'i 'bring bsdus gang 'grub dang*/ 'bring la'ang 'bring lta bu bya'o/ /kun gyi mtha' la rdo ra me ri byas na'ang mi rung ba cher med kyang*/ 'ja' ris dang padma dkar po'i 'dab ma du shong gi zlum skor 'dab ma las 'ja' ris te/ pad 'dab las 'ja' ris 'dab kyi che ba'i zlum thig gsum rim gang 'byor byas pa'i nang du tshangs zur spyi dang 'dra ba byas nas zlum thig nang ma la reg par dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i mda' yab kyi thig byas pa'i nang du phyi ma 'di la rta babs byas na mdzes pas/ rtsig pa 'dod snam sogs logs thig tshang ma ci tsam shong ba'i gzo thig 'di'i rtsa thig nas tshangs thig rgya gram gyi bar sum btubs bya/ de re re yang lnga btubs tshad ldan byas pa'i thig re re bzhin gyi phyi ru rtsig pa dang*/

'dod snam dang nges par dang*/ shong na dra phyed kyang bya ste/ de gnyis rtsig pa las re re zhing nyis 'gyur bya/ de'i phyi ru lha snam dgos pas lnga btubs pa thams cad kyang*/ phyed bshags kyi phyed nang ma la rtsig pa sogs dang*/ phyi ma la lha snam mo/ /sgo ni nang ma'i brgyad cha nges par bya zhing*/ phyi ma'i brgyad cha ni logs thig rnams bzo thig tu song bas ha cang ches yong bas na ci mdzes te/ nang ma'i brgyad cha yong bar thig rtse bzung nas phyi ma'i thad du gang 'tshams bskyed de/ gsegs 'gros su tal mar btab pas sgo thig cig char 'byung la/ 'bri ba'i tshe gsegs kha drang tha dad du bcos nas bris pas shin tu mdzes par 'byung zhing*/ de yang sgo khyud kyi rtsig pa'i phyed du/ rtsigs pa'i ched kyi thig ring ngos re rer yang gnyis gnyis bya'o/ /lha snam bco lnga po thams cad la mchod rten phyogs mdog dang :btun [ stun ] pa'i mdzes tshon/ nang ma nang ma nas phyi ma phyi ma la gnyis gnyis 'phel ba bri zhing*/ dbus ma'i nang du padma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar yum chen mo/ shar du thub pa/ lhor spyan ras gzigs/ nub du mi g.yo ba/ byang du sgrol ma rnams kyi sku bri ba'am/ lugs ma sogs dgod pa'am/ sa bon 'bri ba sogs gang 'grub/ lha snam rnams thams cad ni phyogs mdog bya'o/ /dbang la chu dbang tsam yang mi gsal bar thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi byin brlabs tsam byed par gsal ba ltar/ chu dbang sogs mi byed na/ bum pa bshom sgrub dang snyen pa rgyas par bshad pa dgos med du 'gyur bas/ bum pa so so'i nang gi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum chu dang gcig tu gyur pa'i bum chu thig le re re bzhin bsdus/ bum pa'am dung chos su blug la/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi phyogs cu'i zhing nas sangs rgyas dang byang sems lha dang lha mo/ khro bo khro mo dpag du med pa spyan drangs te slob ma'i steng phyogs su bzhugs/

dbang lha rnams kyi gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod sprin gyis bar snang 'gengs/ me tog dang gur :kum [ gum ] dang tsandan phye ma sogs kyi char 'bebs/ lha'i rnga bo che la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs :gcad [ bcad ] gsung bar mos nas/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs rol mo dang bcas pa rjod/ ji ltar bltams sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shri ye hūm̐/ zhes spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ bum chu sbyin zhing gtor bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag lha rang rang gi sa bon gyis spyi bor brgyan pa la dbang lha bstim pa tsam ni kun la bya'o// spyir ni 'di bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len yin pas/ thig le phyi ma snod bcud spyi'i dag snang bskyed/ de nas gsum/ 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa ste| mdo phyogs kyi rtog pa skyed pa'i dbang dang*/ de nas bzhi bya rgyud/ de nas sgrol ma khro mo dang*/ mi g.yo ba spyod rgyud/ de nas bzhi rnal 'byor rgyud/ nyams len byin brlabs brgyud pa'i rdo rje 'chang bla med spyi/ gnyis med byang sems kyi ngo bo sangs rgyas ni gnyis med rgyud de de ltar na/ mdo phyogs la 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur lta bur byin gyi rlob/ bya rgyud la chu dang cod paṇa/ spyod rgyud la de gnyis dang rdor dril ming*/ rnal 'byor rgyud la de rnams dang dam tshig gsum sbyin gyi rdo rje slob dpon/ bla med la dbang bzhi tshang bar bskur na'ang*/ bla ma dang slob ma kun rgyud sde'i dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i dbang po rab la shin tu'ang rung zhing*/ lam gyi tshe yang de ltar nyams su blang ngo*/ /'dir ni slob ma gtso bor mdo sde la rten nas sems 'dul ba/ rgyud sde la 'dris chung ba'i dbang du byas nas/ gnas skabs kri ya'i lha lnga zhig bya rgyud las gtso bor ston par gsung bas/ sngar bshad pa tsam dang slob ma'ang spyan ras gzigs dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mchog sbyin dang pad dkar 'dzin pa tsam du gsal ba dngos su du yod kyi steng du sems can thams cad kyang rnam pa de lta bur bsgoms pa la dbang bskur zhing*/

gtso bor dad mos dang dag snang skyed du 'jug pa la nan tan bya'o/ /phyi'i bkod pa bsam yas la lha bsgom du bzhug pa tsam las mi gsal yang*/ khrus dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sdom bzung thun mong ba tsam byas nas/ snod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo nas bla ma khrid de nang du slebs pa na/ gzhal yas khang yi ge drug gi rnam ldan mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ pad dkar 'dab ma stong ldan gyi lte ba zhun ma'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa'i thig le dkar po nam mkha' ltar mtha' med pa zhig spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho phyag stong spyan stong nam mkha' gang khyab du skus khyab pa ba spu re re'i bu :kha [ ga ] na yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa rnams na sangs rgyas byang sems grangs med pa dang bcas pa mthong bas/ dad mos bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa kun bzang rnam 'phrul gyi mchod pas mchod par bsam zhing*/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*/ zhes sogs mchod 'bul thun mong ba gang 'grub dang*/ bcu gcig zhal gyi bstod pa bya/ yan lag bdun pa thun mong dang thun mong min pa gang 'grub tshar gsum sogs byas nas/ lha thams cad kyis kyang sngags gsung zhing*/ sems can thams cad kyis kyang zla bar mos nas yig drug zla zhing bskor ba gang 'grub bya/ de nas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byang chub sems kyi 'od zer 'phros pa slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas/ byin gyis brlabs shing*/ bum chus dbang bskur tshul snga ma bzhin byas pas rgyal ba rgya mtsho shin tu dgyes te/ thugs ka'i padmo kha phye ba'i nang du bzhugs nas shāka thub kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa sogs gzhung bzhin la 'di dag sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes pa/ 'brom ston gyi rnam 'phrul stag tshang seng ge rgyal mtshan bzang pos dngos su byin gyis rlabs pa'i lotstsha ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bkod pa'o/
/maṅga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang gi lhan thabs/ -PAGE 404--PAGE 403-- PAGE 400-
